name: vessels
title: Synthetic vessel telemetry
description: Six fictional vessels, one reading every six seconds, 1-14 September 2026 UTC. Speed and wind in knots, wave height in metres, water temperature in °C.
license: Synthetic, generated by the engine (src/engine/dataset.ts); no real data

name: weather
title: Hourly weather in 12 European cities, 2023–2024
description: Hourly weather (ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo) for 12 European cities, 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31 UTC. temperature °C at 2 m, humidity % relative, precipitation mm in the preceding hour, wind_speed km/h at 10 m, cloud_cover % of sky, pressure hPa at mean sea level.
license: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo; ERA5 data: Copernicus Climate Change Service)

name: flights
title: US domestic flights, 2024-06
description: Every domestic flight of the reporting US carriers in June 2024 (BTS on-time data). scheduled_departure is local time at the origin; delays, taxi and air times in minutes (negative delay = early); distance in miles. flights.carrier = carriers.code; flights.origin and flights.dest = airports.code.
license: Public domain (US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics; OurAirports data is public domain)

name: cities
title: World cities over 15,000 inhabitants
description: Every populated place with at least 15,000 inhabitants (GeoNames cities15000) and every country. cities.country_code = countries.code. feature_code: PPLC capital, PPLA first-order admin seat, PPLA2..4 lower seats, PPL other place. elevation in metres (digital elevation model), area_km2 in km², population in people.
